site.name: notion
site.summary: notion-clone Clone of the Notion marketing funnel: home + product sub-pages + templates + pricing. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: top nav (Product / Download / Solutions / Resources / Pricing / Request demo / Log in / Get Notion free), hero section (product positioning + CTA + main screenshot), modular product intros (Docs / Wikis / Projects / AI), customer logo wall, customer stories, multi-column footer | | `projects.html` | Project management sub-page: feature highlights, view-switching screenshots (Board / Timeline / Calendar), case studies, CTA | | `wikis.html` | Wiki sub-page: knowledge-base examples, permissions / search / template features, CTA |

run_plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the Notion clone, validating the marketing funnel from landing to product sub-pages, templates, and pricing.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will start on the homepage to assess the core value proposition and navigation. It will then traverse the product sub-pages (Projects, Wikis) and the Templates directory, ensuring interactive elements like category filters or accordions work. Finally, it will rigorously test the Pricing page's interactive toggles and FAQs, followed by a dedicated mobile pass to verify layout and the flagged small tap targets.
assumptions: The header navigation is consistent across all pages.
The FAQ sections on Pricing and Templates pages use interactive accordions (buttons) that reveal hidden text.
The Pricing page contains a functional Monthly/Yearly toggle that updates price displays.
risk_hotspots: Global navigation links (flagged for small tap targets)
FAQ accordion buttons on pricing.html and templates-projects.html
Multi-column grids on mobile (pricing tiers, template listings)

phases.title: Homepage & Global Navigation
phases.objective: Validate the primary landing page messaging, CTAs, and verify global navigation connectivity.
key_checks: Check hero section CTAs ('Request a demo', 'Get Notion free')
Scroll through feature highlights and customer stories
Click top navigation links to verify routing to sub-pages
exit_criteria: All main navigation links successfully route to their respective pages
Homepage scrolled and major sections observed

phases.title: Product Discovery (Projects & Wikis)
phases.objective: Explore the specific marketing copy and layout for the core product offerings.
key_checks: Observe feature grids and descriptive blocks
Verify internal cross-linking (e.g., links from Projects to Wikis)
exit_criteria: Both projects.html and wikis.html have been visited and scrolled completely

phases.title: Templates & FAQs
phases.objective: Verify the templates layout and interact with the FAQ section.
key_checks: Observe the categorization of templates (Roadmaps, Issue Tracking, etc.)
Click on FAQ buttons (e.g., 'Is Notion good for project management?') to verify accordion expansion
exit_criteria: Templates page visited, and at least two FAQ accordions have been toggled

phases.title: Pricing & Conversion
phases.objective: Thoroughly test the pricing page interactive elements and plan descriptions.
key_checks: Toggle the Monthly/Yearly pricing switch and observe if prices change
Review the plan tiers (Free, Plus, Business, Enterprise)
Click on Pricing FAQ buttons (e.g., 'What is a block?')
exit_criteria: Pricing toggle interacted with and state change verified

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Tap Targets
phases.objective: Switch to mobile viewport to check layout degradation and flagged tap targets.
key_checks: Check global navigation accessibility on mobile (hamburger menu presence/function)
Verify pricing table readability on narrow screens
Assess ease of clicking previously flagged small tap targets (e.g., top nav links)
exit_criteria: Mobile view navigated successfully and UI stacking observed on key pages

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 5 HTML files (index, projects, wikis, templates-projects, pricing)
coverage_targets.features: Exercise Pricing toggle, Templates FAQs, and Pricing FAQs
coverage_targets.mobile: Test global nav, pricing tiers, and FAQ accordions on mobile viewport

notes: Pay special attention to the layout warnings regarding small tap targets (<44px) on links, especially when evaluating the mobile viewport.

Yes. Teams use Notion to manage plans, tasks, timelines, docs, and status updates in one place. Because templates are composable, you can tailor workflows without duct-taping multiple tools together. What project management templates should I start with? Start with a project plan, timeline (Gantt), WBS, RACI, and a weekly status report. These cover the four fundamentals: scope, schedule, ownership, and communication. Can I manage Agile projects in Notion? Yes. Use a backlog and sprint board (Kanban), plus a timeline for capacity planning. Add retrospectives and a change log to complete the loop. What does "composable project management" mean? It's the idea of building your system from modular parts that can be reconfigured as needs change. Your project management tool, built by you, for you. Does Notion support templates for different industries? Yes, Notion offers project templates for various industries, from software and marketing to construction and educ

observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free One tool to run your company. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? Engineering Lead Marcus Johnson Product Designer Aisha Patel Frontend Engineer James Kim Backend Engineer Team Directory by danyanovich FAQs Is Notion good for project management? Yes. Teams use Notion to manage plans, tasks, timelines, docs, and status updates in one place. Because templates are composable, you can tailor workflows without duct-taping multiple tools together. What project management templates should I start with? Start with a project plan, timeline (Gantt), WBS, RACI, and a weekly status report. These cover the four fundamentals: scope, schedule, ownership, and communication. Can I manage Agile projects in Notion? Yes. Use a backlog and sprint board (Kanban), plus a timeline for capacity planning. Add retrospectives and a change log to complete the loop. What does "composable project management" mean? It's the idea of building your system from modular parts that can be reconfigured as needs change. Your project management tool, built by you, for you. Does Notion support templates for different industries? Yes, Notion offers project templates for various industries, from software and marketing to construction and educ

Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle.
